name: gopeed
description_en: A fast, modern download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet, and ed2k. Cross-platform, built with Golang and Flutter.
readme_excerpt: English | 中文 | 日本語 | 正體中文 | Tiếng Việt 🚀 Introduction Gopeed (full name Go Speed), a high-speed downloader developed by Golang + Flutter, supports (HTTP, BitTorrent, Magnet, ED2K) protocol, and supports all platforms. In addition to basic download functions, Gopeed is also a highly customizable downloader that supports implementing more features through integration with APIs or installation and development of extensions.
